text:
Chicago arrives in Tampa on the second night of a back-to-back, winless in four (0-3-1) after a 5-3 loss at Florida last night. The Blackhawks are also without Bowen Byram and Patrick Kane, and Anton Frondell, Roman Kantserov and Wyatt Kaiser are all playing bigger minutes because of it. The Lightning are 2-1-2 in their last five and come in with the night's story: Nikita Kucherov, back on home ice after his trade request, has seven assists in his last four games.

The numbers favor Tampa. At five on five, TBL has taken 55% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) in its games, against 41% for CHI, and our model projects 3.94 goals for the Lightning to 2.62 for Chicago. The Lightning also have the better power play (0.76 expected goals a game to 0.54) and penalty kill. In net, Arvid Soderblom is the projected starter for CHI at -3.5 goals saved above expected this season, while Andrei Vasilevskiy is at -1.5 for TBL, though he was +23.2 last season.

Connor Bedard has a seven-game point streak and is 72% for a point. Brandon Hagel (48% to score) and Kucherov (87% for a point) lead Tampa's list, and Brayden Point is two points from 700 for his career. Our under-the-radar pick is Kantserov, 51% for a point against a season-pace 43%, since his line creates chances. He's a player to watch, not a lock.
